title: RetailOps Demand Forecast Feature Row
description: Observed sale label and forecast-origin-safe fields at date, product, store and channel grain. An absent row is unknown, not zero.

units_sold.description: Forecast target: observed units sold. It is a label, never a same-day model input.

observation_status.description: A zero requires an explicit zero-quantity sale record. Missing, closed, or inactive combinations do not get synthetic zero rows.

observation_available_at.description: Latest ingestion or order creation time contributing to the label. Historical sales can enter lag features only after this time.

generated_at.description: Dataset generation metadata, not source availability at the forecast origin.
